title: Jan-Willem Doornenbal, Risoprint Meerpaaltjes
lede: A two-color riso print of mooring posts and reeds mirrored in water, in a warm pink and a blue that overprint into violet.
summary: Two-color riso photo print in pink and blue, overprinting into violet.

evidence.note: Viewed the 1024 × 577 px Flickr “large” file, a photograph of one sheet. The pink looks warmer and duller than fluorescent ink usually does, possibly because of the camera.

styles.note: Two inks overprint into a third color, with grain and uneven coverage.

context: The Flickr description says: “Vier foto's van paaltjes en riet, gespiegeld in het water.” (Four photos of posts and reeds, mirrored in the water.)
observed: Two inks: a salmon pink and a blue.
Where they overlap, the color is violet, especially in the reeds and reflections.
The ink is patchy, and paper shows through in streaks.
The image fills a long horizontal band with an off-white margin.
interpretation: The work depends on overprint: the violet is not an ink but the overlap of two translucent layers.
borrow: Print the same image in two inks, slightly different in threshold, so the overlap draws the shadows.

images.alt: A wide print of wooden posts and reeds reflected in water, in pink and blue that mix into violet.
